raw_input: hey team cloud db went down yestreday for 4 hours so sprint milestone 2 is delayed to friday 5pm. we still have our weekly sync on wednesday from 2 to 330pm. make shure everyone checks their crs coordinates and api keys before running the new pipeline.

ok so our startup is building developer tools for spatial thinkers. problem is linear keyboards bottleneck rapid parallel ideation. solution is d-mode cognitive compiler. raising 1.5m preseed for 18mo runway. target is 100k arr by month 12.

panel proposal for annual geospatial summit on autonomous earth observation agents. 90 minute session with four panelists covering sensor orchestration, real time edge processing, ethical data governance, and open science standards. need abstracts by october 10.

need approval for lab hardware upgrade before fiscal year end. requisition includes two rtx 4090 workstations for point cloud deep learning, 64tb raid storage array, and 10gbe switch. total cost is 14200eur against remaining equipment budget of 16500eur.

q4 roadmap priorities are shipping native raycast extension, integrating local ollama bridge, and releasing zero install browser playground. deprecating legacy rest endpoint v1 on december 1st. all enterprise customers have already been migrated to v2 api keys.

field expedition schedule for vosges mountain drone lidar survey. team departs strasbourg campus monday 7am. four flight blocks scheduled between 10am and 4pm depending on cloud ceiling. safety protocol requires two visual observers and battery thermal bags.
